signature.one_line: Landscape walk-and-talk: one-word captions, flash-burst hook, corner titles with accent swash-italic word.
unique_devices: Hook line accumulates word by word in one very widely spaced line across the frame (fixed slots, 2-frame fades), then a 4-shot b-roll flash burst at ~0.5 s per shot
Two-line corner titles beside the head: white sans line over one huge accent-gradient swash-italic key word (about 2x the sans height), words fading in one by one
Deliberately quiet running captions: one small white lowercase word at a time on the chest, no emphasis
Half-frame split wipe (b-roll | presenter) used as a transition twice
signature.why_it_works: A confessional contrarian opener plus an early visual jolt; big type is saved for 2-3 key phrases, so they read as headlines over a calm walking monologue.

hook.first_frame: Wide shot of the speaker walking toward camera outside a glass office building with trees, natural daylight; the first words placing themselves across the frame at ~55 % height

structure.what: confessional contrarian line built across the frame, then a 4-shot b-roll flash burst
backstory with a 2-line corner title; founder-at-work b-roll
the reversal: now running a company, systems are needed; studio behind-the-scenes b-roll
generalise across business types; split wipe with team b-roll
consequence line as a corner title with the accent key word
black end card with series logo (no spoken CTA)

pacing.pace: fast, front-loaded (~72 cuts/min in the first ~14 %, then 24-36)

captions.what: one small white lowercase word at a time
captions.how: Inter 500, centred, centre y 55.7 % H on the chest, same position over b-roll; hard cut per word 0-6 frames after the spoken start; no emphasis
words take fixed slots spread across x 15-80 % W at ~55 % H with ~3-5 % W gaps, each fading in over 2 frames, earlier words stay

background_text.what: 2-line corner title: white sans line + accent swash-italic key word
background_text.how: top-left (or top-right) beside the head, left edge ~8.6-17.6 % W; line 1 at 17-23 % H, line 2 at 25-36 % H starting further left and tucked under line 1; words fade in ~3 frames each with slight blur; hold 2-3 s; hard cut out

broll_inserts.how: handheld, 1-2.3 s per shot, warmer/redder interiors; captions keep their chest position
four ~15-frame b-roll shots back to back right after the first line

layout.how: vertical half split wiped in as a transition, then resolves to one side

camera.what: handheld/gimbal walk-and-talk with wide <-> medium alternation

end_card.how: pure black, white monogram (~7 % W on 16:9, ~20 % W on 9:16) centred at 48 % H, small letter-spaced caps brand name (~1.5 % H, tracking ~0.4em) at 54.5 % H

captions_spec.script: latin (spoken words; corner titles in Roman Hinglish)

grouping.words_per_caption: 1 (hook: words accumulate into one spaced line of up to 7 words)
grouping.break: each word replaces the previous one (hard cut)

caption.note: on the presenter's chest; stays at the same screen position on b-roll

layout.hook_line: words placed at fixed positions spread across x 15-80 % W at y ~55 % H with very wide gaps (~3-5 % W), accumulating left to right

corner_title.side: top-left (or top-right) beside the head, never over the face

layout.1080x1920_mapping: centre-crop the 16:9 frame to 9:16: caption stays centred at y 55.7 %; corner titles fall outside the crop, so move them to the top-left safe area (left 8 % W, y 15-32 %) at the mapped size

caption.letterform_evidence: double-storey a, flat-ended d stem, plain grotesque shapes, small size
caption.font_size_note: font_size_px_at_1920 = verified_px (solved on a 1920x1080 canvas) x 1.778, i.e. the same % of frame height on a 1080x1920 canvas
caption.calibration_note: white over a dark shirt (clean); % of the 16:9 frame

title_sans.font_size_note: font_size_px_at_1920 = verified_px (solved on a 1920x1080 canvas) x 1.778
title_sans.calibration_note: 2-word sentence-case line measured at 6.41 % H, 18.2 % W, white over dark trees (clean); source words withheld

title_script.font_class: swash italic serif / script, high contrast

closest_match.google: Playfair Display Italic (low); a swash script such as Great Vibes for the g-loop (low)

title_script.letterform_evidence: italic, thick-thin contrast, long swash descender on g sweeping left under the line
title_script.font_size_note: font_size_px_at_1920 = verified_px (solved on a 1920x1080 canvas) x 1.778
title_script.calibration_note: gold over dark trees (clean); the swash g makes the ink taller than a plain italic
title_script.position: second line, starting 9 % W further left than the sans line and overlapping its descenders

animation.caption_entry: hard cut per word; typically 4-6 frames late vs the spoken start (on-time is fine)
animation.hook_build: each new word fades in over ~2 frames at its fixed slot in the spaced line, earlier words stay
animation.title_build: words of the corner title fade in one by one over ~3 frames with a slight blur; the title holds 2-3 s, then cuts
animation.timing_note: running captions follow the spoken words; corner titles restate the key phrase in Roman Hinglish

other_text_spec.text: 2 lines top-left: white sans 'lead words' / gold swash-italic 'KEY WORD' + optional trailing white sans word
white logo monogram (~7 % W) centred at 48 % H with a letter-spaced caps brand name (~1.5 % H) under it at 54.5 % H

style.look_intent: natural daylight, moderate saturation, soft mid contrast, neutral-warm; greens and glass outdoors, warmer/redder interiors in b-roll

sound.music: music bed likely (heuristic beat ~72 bpm); calm, under the voice; carries the speechless end card
sfx: optional quick swish per flash-montage shot (inferred)
logo sting on the end card (inferred)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: Word-by-Word Pop Captions
catalog_styles.role: one small word at a time on the chest

catalog_styles.name: Oversized Editorial Headlines
catalog_styles.role: corner titles with gold swash-italic key word

catalog_styles.name: Flash-Cut Editing
catalog_styles.role: 4-shot b-roll burst after the hook line

use_when: A founder or leader talking to camera outdoors or on the move, landscape or easily reframed
Hinglish or bilingual speech where 2-3 key phrases deserve big headline treatment
There is founder-at-work / team b-roll to intercut (~25 % of runtime)
A reflective or contrarian opinion piece that should feel premium and calm rather than loud
avoid_when: The goal is maximum caption readability for sound-off viewing (one small word at a time is quiet)
No b-roll exists for the flash burst and intercuts
The face fills the frame so there is no room beside the head for corner titles
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B23 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B23.json) to this brand.
Native canvas 1920x1080 at 30 fps (sizes below give the 16:9 px and the 1080x1920 px for a 9:16 reframe).

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{TEXT}} >= 4.5:1 on the chest; {{ACCENT}} gradient must stay >= 3:1 on the background behind the title, e.g. dark foliage or walls)
- {{TEXT}}: default #FFFFFF (captions, title sans line, end-card wordmark)
- {{ACCENT}}: default #F5D34C (gold gradient light stop)
- {{ACCENT_2}}: default #E0A820 (gold gradient deep stop)
- {{SURFACE}}: none (footage)
- {{CARD_BG}}: default #000000 (end card)
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}}: default Playfair Display 700 italic (a swash italic/script is closer)
- {{FONT_BODY}}: default Inter 500
- {{HANDLE}}: not used
- {{LOGO}}: monogram for the end card

CAPTIONS
1. Latin, as spoken, lowercase except 'I'; no punctuation, no emoji.
2. One word at a time: {{FONT_BODY}} at 43 px on 1920x1080 (76 px on 1080x1920), {{TEXT}}, no stroke, no shadow, no box, tracking 0; centred, centre y 55.7 % H (chest), same position over b-roll.
3. Hook only (first ~7 % of runtime): the opening sentence accumulates in ONE widely spaced line at ~55 % H; each word gets a fixed slot with ~3-5 % W gaps (16:9: x 15-80 %; 9:16: inside x 8-92 %); each word fades in over 2 frames.
4. Each word hard-cuts in 0-6 frames after its spoken start and out when the next starts; no idle motion.

CORNER TITLES (2-3 per minute, for the key phrase)
5. Two lines beside the head, never over the face. Line 1: {{FONT_BODY}} at 79 px on 16:9 (140 px on 9:16), {{TEXT}}, sentence case 'lead words', left edge 8.6 % W, y 17-23 % (9:16: left 8 % W, y 15-21 %). Line 2: the KEY WORD in {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 170 px on 16:9 (302 px on 9:16), vertical gradient {{ACCENT}} -> {{ACCENT_2}}, starting ~3-9 % W further left and tucked under line 1 (y 25-36 %); any trailing word in the white sans.
6. Title words fade in one by one (~3 frames each, slight blur-in), hold 2-3 s, hard cut out.

EDIT DEVICES
7. Right after the first line: 4 b-roll shots of ~15 frames each (flash burst).
8. Alternate WS and MS (~130 %) every 1.5-3 s; intercut founder-at-work b-roll for ~25 % of runtime, 1-2.3 s per shot.
9. Twice per piece, a half-frame split wipe (b-roll | presenter) as the transition.
10. End card (last ~10 %): {{CARD_BG}}, {{LOGO}} monogram (~7 % W on 16:9, ~20 % W on 9:16) centred at 48 % H, letter-spaced caps brand name (~1.5 % H, tracking ~0.4em) at 54.5 % H. No lower-thirds, no emoji.

GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: natural daylight, moderate saturation, soft mid contrast, neutral-warm.
SOUND: calm music bed (~72 bpm) under the voice, carrying the end card; keep true peak below -1 dBTP; -14 LUFS.

VERIFY
a) Render the caption word "and" at 43 px on 1920x1080 (or 76 px on 1080x1920) over a dark area at 55.7 % H and measure:
   python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test_render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.4,0.5,0.6,0.61 --ink "{{TEXT}}:60"   (default ink #FFFFFF)
   Required (16:9 frame): 2.65 % ±0.5 of H, 4.5 % ±2 of W; "processes" 2.79 % H, 13.0 % W.
b) Corner title: render "grow" in {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 170 px (16:9) and measure with --ink "{{ACCENT}}:90": 11.0 % ±0.5 H, 22.2 % ±2 W.
c) Expected ink for any other word: video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "{{FONT_BODY}}" --word <word> --canvas 1920x1080.
